# 3 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> Ideal three bedroom semi detached family home, off Dalston Road, West Carlisle. The accommodation offers entrance hallway, living room, kitchen, dining room and conservatory. The first floor has three bedrooms and bathroom. Externally is a low maintenance front garden, driveway, garage and rear garden with decked area. Situation Situated between Wigton Road and Dalston Road.
